gaps.sentence: He was born in ___ Netherlands, not in Belgium.
gaps.explanation: Country names that are plural or contain 'Kingdom/Republic/States' take 'the': the Netherlands.

gaps.sentence: ___ sun sets much later in summer.
gaps.explanation: 'The sun' — there is only one, so the definite article is used.

gaps.sentence: It was such ___ awful weather that we stayed indoors.
gaps.explanation: Uncountable nouns take no article after 'such': such awful weather.

gaps.sentence: ___ curiosity killed the cat, as they say.
gaps.explanation: 'Curiosity' as an abstract quality takes no article, even in the proverb.

gaps.sentence: She got ___ injury during the warm-up.
gaps.explanation: 'An injury' — vowel sound; 'during the warm-up' is the specific one.

gaps.sentence: ___ honesty is the best policy, as the saying goes.
gaps.explanation: Abstract nouns used in a general sense take no article: honesty, happiness, love.

gaps.sentence: They organized ___ charity concert for flood victims.
gaps.explanation: 'A charity concert' — one of many possible concerts, first mention.

gaps.sentence: This is ___ second time you've been late this week.
